label: Uneasy calm
summary: Democrats won control of both houses of Congress in a US midterm vote widely read as a rebuke of Trump, who said he would accept the result; Georgia elected the first Black woman governor of any state. Abroad the mood was harder. Trump confirmed strikes on Iran as Tehran called Washington's Hormuz reply unconvincing and readied a 'maximum deterrence' plan, and a tanker was hit near Oman. The toll from Russia's strike on a Ukrainian aid site reached 31, with dozens missing, ahead of talks in Abu Dhabi next week. North Korea fired missiles for the fourth time in a month, and a party organiser was shot before South Africa's local elections. Asian stocks fell with Brent just under $104, New Zealand unemployment hit an 11-year high, and Bolivia declared an El Niño emergency. Five people survived three months adrift in the Pacific. The weighted formula gave 43; no editorial adjustment.
